{"parentUuid":"b7ea9e4f-69a6-425e-af7d-ee2d0327585b","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer -- your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.\n\nDo not use for: refactoring, writing scripts from scratch, debugging business logic, code review, or general programming concepts.","## plugin:serena:serena\nCRITICAL: Before starting to work on a coding task, call the `initial_instructions` tool to read the 'Serena Instructions Manual'."],"removedNames":[]},"type":"attachment","uuid":"72894a9b-0e68-4729-870b-c6d2c21008fe","timestamp":"2026-05-06T10:37:06.276Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"dc47f5fb-3322-4d5d-be02-b08995cddf58","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"72894a9b-0e68-4729-870b-c6d2c21008fe","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. {"parentUuid":"e4a00984-008c-4314-9c80-0f573ae4cbdc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"20cf8cff-598f-4d83-a5b8-aa47473c7071","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HPExmZR5bQEkrhNGbLgRyF","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# PROJECT CHARTER\n2\t## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n3\t\n4\t> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n5\t> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n6\t> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n7\t\n8\t---\n9\t\n10\t## Vision\n11\t\n12\tAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n13\t\n14\tPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n15\t\n16\tPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n17\t\n18\tNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n19\t\n20\t---\n21\t\n22\t## The Core Insight (the why)\n23\t\n24\t**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n25\t\n26\t**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n27\t- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n28\t- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n29\t- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n30\t- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n31\t- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n32\t- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n33\t\n34\tIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n35\t\n36\tThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n37\t\n38\t---\n39\t\n40\t## The Craft Philosophy\n41\t\n42\tTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n43\t\n44\t- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n45\t- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n46\t- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n47\t- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n48\t- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n49\t\n50\tReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n51\t\n52\t---\n53\t\n54\t## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n55\t\n56\t1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n57\t\n58\t2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n59\t\n60\t3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n61\t\n62\t4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n63\t\n64\t5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n65\t\n66\t6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n67\t\n68\t7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n69\t\n70\t8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n71\t\n72\t9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n73\t\n74\t10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n75\t\n76\t---\n77\t\n78\t## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n79\t\n80\tSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n81\t\n82\t**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n83\t\n84\t**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n85\t\n86\t**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n87\t\n88\t**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n89\t\n90\tThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n91\t\n92\tSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n93\t\n94\t---\n95\t\n96\t## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n97\t\n98\t**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n99\t- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n100\t- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n101\t- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n102\t- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n103\t\n104\tOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n105\t\n106\t---\n107\t\n108\t## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n109\t\n110\t- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n111\t- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n112\t- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n113\t- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n114\t- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n115\t- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n116\t\n117\t---\n118\t\n119\t## Success Criteria\n120\t\n121\t**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n122\t- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n123\t- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n124\t- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n125\t- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n126\t\n127\t**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n128\t- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n129\t- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n130\t- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n131\t- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n132\t\n133\t**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n134\t- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n135\t- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n136\t- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n137\t- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n138\t\n139\t**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n140\t- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n141\t- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n142\t- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n143\t- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n144\t\n145\t**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n146\t\n147\t---\n148\t\n149\t## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n150\t\n151\t**Stack:**\n152\t- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n153\t- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n154\t- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n155\t- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n156\t- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n157\t- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n158\t- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n159\t- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n160\t- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n161\t\n162\t**Architecture:**\n163\t- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n164\t- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n165\t- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n166\t- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n167\t\n168\t**Development approach:**\n169\t- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n170\t- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n171\t- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n172\t- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n173\t- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n174\t\n175\t---\n176\t\n177\t## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n178\t\n179\t**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n180\t- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n181\t- Vietstock public — financial reports\n182\t- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n183\t- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n184\t- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n185\t- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n186\t\n187\t**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n188\t- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n189\t- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n190\t- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n191\t\n192\t**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n193\t\n194\t---\n195\t\n196\t## Meta-Discipline\n197\t\n198\tThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n199\t\n200\t- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n201\t- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n202\t- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n203\t- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n204\t- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n205\t- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n206\t\n207\t---\n208\t\n209\t## Revision Protocol\n210\t\n211\tThis charter changes only when:\n212\t- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n213\t- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n214\t- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, Quick wins are anti-pattern.\n257\t"}]},"uuid":"221766e5-af6f-4904-9bcf-30d2783e34ab","timestamp":"2026-05-06T10:37:17.163Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\PROJECT_CHARTER.md","content":"# PROJECT CHARTER\n## StockForge — Personal Investment Advisor for Vietnamese Stock Market\n\n> **Status**: Immutable v1.0 — changes require explicit charter revision.\n> **Scope of immutability**: Vision, principles, success criteria.\n> **Things that do evolve**: Agent configs, specs, implementation, signal weights, eval sets.\n\n---\n\n## Vision\n\nAn AI-first investment research and advisory system that combines **quant fund methodology** with **Vietnam-specific edge sources** (KOL networks, crowd sentiment, pump pattern detection) to surface high-conviction opportunities in an inefficient market where logic-based screening alone is insufficient.\n\nPrimary user: project owner (self) + 3-5 trusted peers in Vietnamese investing community.\n\nPrimary goal: build a system that compounds edge over time through proprietary data accumulation, not through any single clever algorithm. After 12-24 months of dogfood, the system should be a genuine advisor I would pay money for if someone else built it.\n\nNot a goal: high-frequency trading, replacing human judgment, becoming a SaaS in Year 1, beating frontier LLMs at general reasoning, providing licensed financial advice.\n\n---\n\n## The Core Insight (the why)\n\n**Quant funds (Renaissance, Two Sigma, DE Shaw) win in efficient markets through clean data + execution speed + diverse alpha factors.** They don't use sentiment from Facebook/YouTube because at their scale it's noise, not signal — and in efficient markets it gets arbitraged away anyway.\n\n**Vietnam stock market inverts this.** It is structurally inefficient:\n- 85-90% retail investor share (vs 20-25% in US)\n- Information asymmetry between sophisticated and retail crowd\n- KOL/influencer recommendations measurably move prices\n- \"Đội lái\" (pump operators) operate openly\n- News and narrative cycles dominate over fundamentals for months at a time\n- Foreign flow creates non-fundamental price pressure\n\nIn this market, **sentiment + influence + narrative tracking is signal, not noise**. And LLMs can process Vietnamese unstructured text at scale that was impossible before 2023.\n\nThis creates a **structural arbitrage**: apply quant methodology + LLM reasoning + sentiment/influence data layers that no commercial product offers for VN. Position not as \"decision maker\" but as **advisor + alert watcher + bias mirror**.\n\n---\n\n## The Craft Philosophy\n\nTake the craft seriously. Build for personal use first, commercial second.\n\n- Production-grade engineering standards from Day 1 (DDD + clean architecture + multi-loop discipline)\n- Commercial extension kept as option, never as driver\n- When self-use conflicts with hypothetical-future-SaaS, self-use wins\n- Quality bar: I genuinely trust output enough to act on real money decisions\n- Edge comes from compounding moats (proprietary data, calibration, personal bias log), not from any single feature\n\nReference models: Renaissance Technologies (data + iteration discipline), Bridgewater (principles-based decision making), personal Bloomberg Terminal (data density + analysis depth), Athletic.com (subscription-quality content for niche audience).\n\n---\n\n## Core Principles (non-negotiable)\n\n1. **Evidence grounding** — every claim, every number traceable to source + as-of date. Hallucination in finance = bug, not stylistic issue.\n\n2. **Structured output over narrative** — multi-criteria assessment, never single \"buy/sell\" score. Output is trade-off matrix.\n\n3. **Adversarial by design** — bear + bull + critic + quant + behavior + manager perspectives. Never consensus from single agent.\n\n4. **Proprietary data moat** — every news ingested, every KOL recommendation tracked, every thesis post-mortem'd compounds the edge. Raw data is sacred.\n\n5. **Pattern transfer + local adaptation** — global setups (cyclical bottom, dividend value, GARP) + Vietnam-specific overlays (policy timing, foreign flow, narrative phase).\n\n6. **Human-in-loop is the product** — augment thinking, never replace it. System should challenge user's gut instinct without overriding it.\n\n7. **Dogfood mandatory** — if I don't use it weekly for real decisions, the feature gets killed. Self-use is the only validation that matters in Year 1.\n\n8. **Calibration over confidence** — system tracks its own accuracy across signal types, never claims confidence it hasn't earned through hit rate.\n\n9. **No LLM math** — LLM never generates numbers. All calculations through deterministic code with verified data inputs. LLM only interprets.\n\n10. **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic** — code-enforced rules, LLM cannot override. Maximum position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules are immutable per session.\n\n---\n\n## The Four-Tier Signal Architecture\n\nSystem operates on four distinct signal tiers, each with different lead time, reliability, and processing approach:\n\n**Tier 1 — Hard Data (deterministic):** prices, volumes, fundamentals, foreign flow, macro indicators. Zero LLM, pure code. Lead time: hours-days.\n\n**Tier 2 — Official Narrative (semi-structured):** mainstream financial news, broker reports, official company disclosures, government announcements. LLM extracts claims + classifies sentiment + detects contradictions. Lead time: real-time.\n\n**Tier 3 — Influence Network (semi-structured):** YouTube channels, Facebook KOL pages, Telegram channels, podcasts. LLM transcribes + extracts recommendations + tags entities. Calibration database tracks each KOL's accuracy over time. Lead time: can lead by days.\n\n**Tier 4 — Crowd Sentiment & Pump Detection (unstructured):** community forums, public chat groups, comments. LLM classifies sentiment + detects coordinated posting + identifies pump narratives + tracks narrative lifecycle phase. Lead time: typically lags price (signals exhaustion).\n\nThe combination — when Tier 1+2+3 agree before Tier 4 heats up = early opportunity; when Tier 4 hot but Tier 1+2 don't support = likely top — is the core analytical edge.\n\nSee `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` for detailed tier specs.\n\n---\n\n## First Sub-Scope (locked 6 months)\n\n**Vietnam stocks listed on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM**, specifically:\n- VN30 + mid-cap (vốn hóa 2,000-50,000 tỷ VND) for primary coverage\n- Long-only equity strategies (no derivatives, no shorting)\n- Holding periods: 1-month minimum, 6-24 month preferred\n- Position sizing per stock: 5-15% of portfolio\n\nOut of scope (Year 1): derivatives, warrants (CW), short selling, cryptocurrency, fund products, foreign markets, day trading, automated execution.\n\n---\n\n## Honest Boundaries (what system does NOT do)\n\n- **Predict price** — system predicts narrative phase, money flow direction, mispricing level. Never a price target with false precision.\n- **Replace fundamental research** — surfaces opportunities, user must verify thesis before acting.\n- **Execute trades** — pure research/alert tool. Execution stays manual.\n- **Provide licensed financial advice** — personal research aid only. Output explicitly framed as \"thesis exploration\", not \"buy/sell recommendation\".\n- **Time the market precisely** — works on phase identification (early/mid/late), not on tick-level timing.\n- **Insider information** — uses only public sources. No paid leaks, no insider channels, no anything that crosses legal/ethical lines.\n\n---\n\n## Success Criteria\n\n**Month 3 (end of Phase 1 — Foundation):**\n- Tier 1 + 2 data pipeline operational for VN30\n- 50 companies have basic dossier in wiki\n- First 5 thesis recorded with formal structure\n- Can run /thesis-validate on a stock end-to-end in <5 minutes\n\n**Month 6 (end of Phase 2 — Edge Sources):**\n- 30+ KOL channels tracked, calibration database has >100 recommendations with outcomes pending\n- Tier 3 + 4 ingestion operational for top 100 stocks\n- First detectable pump pattern caught (warning issued before public dump)\n- 20+ thesis logged, first 5 hit 3-month review\n\n**Month 9 (end of Phase 3 — Multi-perspective):**\n- Bear/bull/critic/quant/macro/behavior agents operational\n- Pattern library has 15+ Vietnam-specific patterns with outcome data\n- Personal bias log shows 3+ identified biases\n- Thesis hit rate measurable (statistically meaningful sample)\n\n**Month 12 (end of Phase 4 — Compounding):**\n- Karpathy outer loop optimizing signal weights weekly\n- Cross-validation: system suggestions vs my manual analysis = where do they diverge?\n- 3-5 trusted peers using it, providing feedback\n- Demonstrable alpha vs VN-Index on dogfood portfolio (or honest accounting of why not)\n\n**Ultimate signal of success**: When my gut says \"buy XYZ\", I check what StockForge says first — and seriously consider it when it disagrees.\n\n---\n\n## Technical Foundation (locked Phase 1-3)\n\n**Stack:**\n- **Python primary** — for data science, LLM workflows, time-series, backtesting (heavier than IdeaForge which was TS-primary)\n- **Postgres 16 + TimescaleDB + pgvector + pg_trgm** — single DB for time-series + relational + vector\n- **Redis** — cache + pub/sub + queue broker\n- **Cloudflare R2** — raw content storage (PDFs, transcripts, scraped pages)\n- **Claude API primary** — Sonnet for most tasks, Opus for thesis synthesis\n- **OpenAI embeddings** — text-embedding-3-small (Vietnamese acceptable)\n- **NestJS** — only if/when we need a public-facing API (Phase 4+)\n- **Streamlit/Next.js** — Streamlit for personal dashboard (Phase 1-2), Next.js if SaaS path\n- **Apache Airflow / Prefect** — data pipeline orchestration\n\n**Architecture:**\n- Clean Architecture with DDD tactical patterns (same as IdeaForge)\n- 9 bounded contexts (see `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md`)\n- Event-driven for cross-context communication\n- Multi-loop execution (Karpathy outer + Continuous middle + Per-stock inner)\n\n**Development approach:**\n- AI-first: Claude Code as primary builder, human as spec author + reviewer + bias-checker\n- Spec-Driven (SDD) + Domain-Driven (DDD) + selective BDD\n- Sandwich pattern (Architect → Dev → Verifier) from Day 1\n- Verify-Before-Write (VBW) protocol mandatory\n- Three-tier quality gates (deterministic / probabilistic / human)\n\n---\n\n## Data Sources (Tier 1 budget)\n\n**Free/cheap (Phase 1):**\n- vnstock (open source) — historical EOD, fundamentals\n- Vietstock public — financial reports\n- TCBS API — semi-public market data\n- CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz — news scraping\n- Public YouTube channels — transcript via yt-dlp + Whisper\n- Public Facebook fanpages — selective scraping (legal grey, careful scope)\n\n**Paid (Phase 2-3 if budget allows):**\n- FiinPro Platform — comprehensive fundamental data (~30-100M VND/year)\n- Wichart — pre-cleaned data\n- SSI FastConnect — realtime quotes if needed\n\n**Budget cap Year 1**: 50M VND for data + LLM combined.\n\n---\n\n## Meta-Discipline\n\nThese charter principles override daily decisions:\n\n- **When in doubt, simplify** — minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative\n- **Ship thin slices, not perfect systems** — each phase ends with something I actually use\n- **Document what you learn, not what you plan** — post-mortem > prospective docs\n- **Dogfood or delete** — features I don't use weekly get removed\n- **Calibrate, don't guess** — every confidence claim must have outcome tracking\n- **Stay agnostic about commercial outcome** — build for the craft, not for the exit\n\n---\n\n## Revision Protocol\n\nThis charter changes only when:\n- A core principle proves materially wrong through 30+ hours of real use\n- Scope demonstrably needs revision based on accumulated dogfood data\n- Technical foundation invalidated by external event (tool deprecation, regulatory change, etc.)\n\nCharter revisions require:\n- Written rationale with evidence (linked to specific sessions/post-mortems)\n- 48-hour cool-down before committing change\n- Explicit version bump (v1.0 → v2.0)\n\nMinor clarifications go in `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`. This charter stays stable.\n\n---\n\n## Document Index\n\n| Document | Purpose | Stability |\n|---|---|---|\n| `PROJECT_CHARTER.md` (this) | Vision + principles | Immutable for ~3 months |\n| `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md` | Agent configs, skills, workflows | Living, frequent updates |\n| `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md` | How to write specs | Stable |\n| `specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md` | Strategic: signal architecture | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/001-validate-investment-thesis.md` | First implementation spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/002-influence-network-tracking.md` | KOL tracking system spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/003-crowd-sentiment-pump-detection.md` | Pump detection spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/004-multi-perspective-adversarial-agents.md` | Adversarial analysis spec | Stable |\n| `specs/tier2-feature/005-karpathy-outer-loop.md` | Pipeline self-optimization spec | Stable |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` | Current state | Continuously updated |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules | Append-mostly |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/` | All thesis ever recorded | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/post-mortems/` | Thesis outcome reviews | Append-only |\n| `agent-workspace/calibration/` | KOL accuracy, signal calibration data | Continuously updated |\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Charter (what we explicitly reject)\n\nTo stay focused, we reject these tempting paths:\n\n- **Predict prices with ML models** — models trained on VN price data overfit; no edge there.\n- **Compete with broker research** — we have less data, less staff. We win on integration + edge sources, not on raw analysis depth.\n- **Build for general retail public** — we build for ourselves and 3-5 peers. Mass market needs hand-holding we won't provide.\n- **Trust LLM for numbers** — every numerical output must come from code with traceable inputs.\n- **Build features without dogfooding** — speculative features die fast in this project.\n- **Optimize for backtest performance** — Goodhart's Law is real. We optimize for forward decision quality.\n- **Make money fast** — this is a 24-month project minimum to reach edge. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Heuristic; not implemented; rule-codification (L-S80-1) is the primary defense.\n\n---\n\n### M-S98-1: sync-tracker-update.sh arg position misuse — long reason text passed as $3 OVERRIDE_DELTA, awk replay coerced non-numeric to 0, sample++ but no value delta\n\n**Date**: 2026-05-06 (S98 T1 sync-grilling auto-tier; caught + recovered same-turn)\n**Session**: S98 (caught immediately on state.tsv verification step; recovered before T4 memory close)\n**Severity**: low (no production state corruption — recovered via row-truncate + re-invoke before any downstream consumer read state.tsv; ~0.4K main token overhead vs clean call)\n\n**What went wrong**:\n- Invoked `bash scripts/hooks/sync-tracker-update.sh SCOPE charter_match \"S98 sync-grilling refresher: ...\"` with long reason text as `$3`\n- Script signature: `<category> <event_type> [<override_delta>] [<decision_id> [<source_evidence> [<reason>]]]`\n- `$3` is OVERRIDE_DELTA (intended numeric like 0.2); long reason text landed there\n- Script appended events.tsv row with `DELTA=\"S98 sync-grilling refresher...\"` (text in `$4` position of TSV)\n- awk replay logic (`s[$2] += $4 + 0`) coerces non-numeric to 0 → SCOPE value did NOT move (52.5 unchanged), but sample count incremented (39→40)\n- state.tsv verification revealed mismatch: expected 52.5→52.7 (per weight_charter_match=0.2), got 52.5 with sample 40\n\n**Root cause**: Argument-position confusion. Did NOT consult script `--help` / signature comment block before invoking; assumed positional convention \"<category> <event_type> <reason>\" without verifying. The script's flexible signature (override_delta optional → empty string opts out) is well-documented in source comment block (lines 6-8) but I skipped that read.\n\n**How recovered** (same-turn, same session):\n1. Detected mismatch via `grep \"^SCOPE\" state.tsv` showing 52.5 with sample 40 (not expected 52.7)\n2. Read script source — confirmed `$3` is OVERRIDE_DELTA, awk numeric coercion at line 116\n3. Truncated bad events.tsv row: `head -163 events.tsv > events.tsv.tmp && mv events.tsv.tmp events.tsv` (164→163 lines)\n4. Re-invoked with correct positional args: `bash sync-tracker-update.sh SCOPE charter_match \"\" \"sync-grilling-S98\" \"agent-workspace/memory/sync-state.md\" \"S98 sync-grilling refresher: ...\"`\n5. Empty `\"\"` as `$3` → script picks up weight_charter_match=0.2 from weights.yaml (correct default behavior)\n6. Final state.tsv verified: SCOPE 52.5→52.7 (+0.2 ✓), sample 39→40, last_updated_ts 10:40:06Z\n\n**Prevention rule** (codified S98 same-turn):\n1. **Pre-invoke signature read**: before invoking ANY hook script with optional positional args, read the script's usage comment block (typically lines 1-15 of `*.sh`) to confirm positional contract. Not memory; source-of-truth.\n2. **Default-delta-via-empty-string convention**: when relying on weights.yaml default lookup for sync-tracker-update.sh, ALWAYS pass `\"\"` as `$3` OVERRIDE_DELTA, then continue with `$4`=decision_id, `$5`=source_evidence, `$6`=reason. Never collapse `$3` by skipping it.\n3. **Future deterministic check** (deferred; LOW ROI): wrapper script `sync-grilling-call.sh` could enforce \"category + event_type + auto-decision-id + auto-source + reason\" 5-arg contract, hiding the override_delta optional. Defer indefinitely — once-pattern call site, ~5/year invocations; rule-codification is sufficient.\n\n**Recurrence risk**: LOW after rule codification (this entry + future S99+ session logs reference). The mistake is invocation-only (no production code regression); auto-detect via state.tsv post-invoke verification (which I performed — that's how I caught it) is already the deterministic check.\n\n**Cost**: ~0.4K main tokens (1 bad-row truncate + 1 re-invoke + 1 verify cycle). NO subagent burn. NO downstream consumer corruption (caught before _index.md auto-render reflected stale state, and the second-call render overwrote with correct state).\n\n**Where applied**:\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/events.tsv` (164→163 truncate + 163→164 well-formed re-append)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv` (SCOPE 52.7 ✓ post-recovery)\n- This entry (M-S98-1)\n- S98 session log T1 documents recovery\n- Future S99+ sessions: when invoking sync-tracker-update.sh, use empty `\"\"` as `$3` per rule 2 above\n\n**Auto-detect signature**: post-invoke `grep \"^SCOPE\" state.tsv` (or appropriate category) to verify expected value-delta was applied. If observed delta ≠ weight_<event_type> from weights.yaml → suspect arg-position bug. {"parentUuid":"fe6b26a3-923a-48e1-bfbe-6826355e691c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01DEMULZfjgw8eUMyyWSBJxW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"# RCA: Tracking-System Bloat — Priority #1\n\nUser signal: tracking đã trở thành **harness gap nặng**. Chi phí > giá trị. Tôi đã save tracking minimum (checkpoint S98 + session log + M-S98-1) và **deliberate skip current-execution.md prepend** (chính nó là Exhibit A — 304 KB > 256 KB Read tool limit ⇒ tool đã không đọc nổi rồi).\n\n---\n\n## Phần 1: Audit empirical (số liệu thật, lúc S98 close)\n\n| File / Dir | Size | LOC | Hook reader count | Trạng thái |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| `current-execution.md` | **304 KB** ⚠️ | 2738 | **34 hook files** | EXCEEDS Read 256KB; broken |\n| `agent-notes.md` | 216 KB | 2008 | 10 hook files | Mỗi `continue` LLM phải đọc head → consume context |\n| `mistake-log.md` | 116 KB | 1175 | 8 hook files | Append-only, không có retention |\n| `current-execution-archive.md` | 172 KB | — | 0 reader hook | Đã archive 1 lần, vẫn lớn — ai đọc? |\n| `component-telemetry.jsonl` | **2.3 MB** | — | 6 hook (writers + 1-2 reader) | Append every event, không rotate |\n| `handoff-logs/` | 1.7 MB | — | ? | Chưa rõ ai đọc |\n| `sessions/` | 1.4 MB | 104 files | Hiếm khi đọc back | Flat tree |\n| `observations/` | 525 KB | — | Subagent return artifacts | Cleaned periodically? |\n| `checkpoints/` | 277 KB | — | session-start-bootstrap | latest.md + timestamped historical |\n| `decisions/` | 472 KB | — | ADR registry consumers | OK (sequential, designed) |\n| **Total `memory/`** | **≈ 6.4 MB** | — | — | — |\n\nThêm: **71 hooks** tổng cộng (69 `.sh`). Mỗi Stop event fire ~10-20 hooks; mỗi hook đọc ≥1 hot file.\n\n---\n\n## Phần 2: Reader/writer matrix các hot file\n\n**`current-execution.md` (304 KB / 34 references)** — đại đa số là HOOK READ:\n- `session-start-bootstrap.sh` — đọc top section khi boot\n- `bootstrap-summary-renderer.sh` — render boot-summary từ top\n- `budget-watchdog.sh` — đọc để biết phase\n- `project-md-staleness-check.sh` — diff với project.md\n- `harness-recovery-dod-watchdog.sh` — recovery state\n- `stale-prompt-detector.sh` — cross-ref session refs trong prompt\n- `tool-call-first-lint.sh` — first tool call gate\n- ... thêm 10+ hooks. **Tất cả chỉ cần TOP 1-3 sessions** (≈ <30 KB) — phần còn lại 274 KB là dead weight cho hook reads.\n\n**`agent-notes.md` (216 KB / 10 references)** — mixed:\n- `lesson-synthesis-watchdog.sh` — đếm new lessons since last promote → cần wc-l + tail không cần full read\n- `index-registry-renderer.sh` — render headers index → cần grep `^### L-S` chứ không cần body\n- `memory-routing-audit.sh` — audit routing rules → cần grep specific terms\n- `write-vs-edit-guard.sh` — guard\n- `continue-injector.ps1` — inject context → ĐÂY là cái load full vào LLM context khi `continue`\n- LLM tự đọc khi viết lessons mới\n- LLM tự đọc khi audit L-S87-1 (mỗi session, ~0.4K main)\n\n**`mistake-log.md` (116 KB / 8 references)** — Mostly LINTER + RENDERER:\n- `session-end-checklist-linter.sh` — kiểm tra entry M-S<N>-X\n- `index-registry-renderer.sh` — render mistake index\n- LLM đọc khi học từ failures (rare, on-demand)\n\n**`component-telemetry.jsonl` (2.3 MB)** — Mostly WRITER (append):\n- `component-telemetry.sh` — writer (Stop hook every event)\n- `self-awareness-aggregate.sh` — reader (period rollup)\n- `profile-template-auto-populate.sh` — reader\n- **Question**: 2.3 MB JSONL từ bao giờ? Có rotation policy chưa?\n\n---\n\n## Phần 3: Cost/Benefit imbalance — Exhibit A là S91→S98\n\n**Cycle đã quan sát được**:\n- S86 codify L-S87-1 (audit backlog claims mỗi session)\n- S87-S89 catch 3 lỗi soft (5x/categorical/framing/1.27x) → có giá trị\n- S90-S93 4-clean → catch-rate giảm\n- S92 codify L-S90-1 (lesson VỀ L-S87-1 — \"verification rule creates self-tightening loop\")\n- S94 catch 1 lỗi soft 1.14x → \"L-S90-1 refinement inline\"\n- S95-S98 4-clean → catch-rate = 0/4\n- S97 fire dormancy watchdog → defer codify L-S94-1 (nhưng vẫn xem xét nó!)\n- S98 vẫn audit, vẫn tốn ~0.4K main, vẫn output \"clean\"\n\n**Empirical cost**:\n- 8 sessions (S91→S98) × ~0.4-1K main per audit = ~5-8K main TỔNG cho L-S87-1 cycle\n- Catch rate post-S94: 1/5 ≈ 20%; magnitude detected ≤ 1.14x = soft, low-impact\n- Dormancy reflection itself tốn S92 + S97 = ~1K main\n- L-S90-1 codification: +67 LOC vào agent-notes.md (file đã 2008 LOC) → mỗi `continue` mọi LLM session sau đều phải load thêm\n- **Net giá trị business = gần 0** (ZERO product-side bug caught; catch chỉ là tally off-by-one trong narrative session log)\n\nĐúng như user nói: chi phí tracking >> giá trị tracking. **Self-recursive trap**.\n\n---\n\n## Phần 4: Root causes (5 traps)\n\n**T1 — Append-only without retention floor.**\n- agent-notes / mistake-log / current-execution không có cap.\n- Mỗi session prepend ~10 KB vào current-execution → tuyến tính bùng. \n- Đã 1 lần archive (`current-execution-archive.md` 172 KB) nhưng không có hook tự động rotate; lần archive tiếp theo cần tay.\n\n**T2 — Self-recursive codification (lesson về lesson về lesson).**\n- L-S87-1 audits backlog claims.\n- L-S90-1 audits how L-S87-1 affects future agents.\n- L-S94-1 (deferred) sẽ audit how L-S87-1 + L-S90-1 differ by defect class.\n- Mỗi rule mới → +50-70 LOC vào agent-notes + 1 line anchor cần track + audit ritual mỗi session.\n- Đây là LLM-Guardian creep (anti-pattern AP-23 đã ghi nhận trong codebase) nhưng deterministic-hook-disguised.\n\n**T3 — Hook fan-out không centralized index.**\n- 34 hooks đọc current-execution.md, 10 đọc agent-notes.md → mỗi Stop event = nhiều I/O cùng file lớn.\n- Hooks chỉ cần METADATA (headers, counts, top section) nhưng đọc FULL file vì không có index file dedicated.\n- `boot-summary.md` (46 LOC, 4 KB) đã làm điều này cho session-start nhưng không mở rộng cho tất cả hot files.\n\n**T4 — Lẫn lộn purpose: audit-log vs working-memory.**\n- Tracking files đang đóng 2 vai mâu thuẫn:\n  - **Audit log**: ghi forensically để trace later — write-often-read-rare\n  - **Working memory**: load mỗi session để inform decisions — read-often\n- Cùng 1 file phải vừa thoả 2 ⇒ hỏng cả hai. Audit log ngắn dễ dùng → bị bloat. Working memory đủ context → bị tail noise.\n\n**T5 — Ritual entrenchment (sunk-cost).**\n- Mỗi session \"phải\" L-S87-1 audit + drift-rollup re-scan + sync-grilling refresh + write S<N> session log + prepend current-execution + replace checkpoint + append mistake-log nếu có.\n- **Giá trị thực**: handoff state recovery. **Cost thực**: 30-50% main session token cho bookkeeping.\n- Khi catch-rate = 0 ritual vẫn tự duy trì vì có \"rule binding\" nhắc nó binding → tự khoá.\n\n---\n\n## Phần 5: Layered restructure proposal\n\n### Layer 1 — Cap & compact (mechanical, low risk; 1 session impl)\n- `agent-notes.md` cap **500 LOC**. Vượt → archive lessons cũ ra `agent-notes/archive/YYYY-MM-lessons.md` + giữ 1-line digest theo lesson ID trong file chính.\n- `current-execution.md` cap **last 5 sessions inline** (~50 KB). Phần còn lại auto-move sang `current-execution/archive/YYYY-MM.md`.\n- `mistake-log.md` cap **200 LOC**. Vượt → archive theo session range.\n- `component-telemetry.jsonl` rotate **weekly**, retain **4 tuần** max, archive `component-telemetry.YYYY-WNN.jsonl.gz`.\n- Triển khai: 1 bash hook `tracking-retention.sh` chạy daily Stop event + đặt rule trong CLAUDE.md.\n- **Fix tool-limit issue ngay lập tức** + giảm hook I/O 5-10×.\n\n### Layer 2 — Stop self-recursive codification (decision, immediate)\n- L-S87-1 catch-rate 0/4 over S95-S98 ⇒ DEMOTE to **passive rule**: ghi rule trong agent-notes nhưng KHÔNG audit mỗi session. Re-engage chỉ khi 1 dấu hiệu cụ thể (e.g., backlog description bị ai đó question).\n- L-S90-1: STOP refining inline. Không codify L-S94-1 (đã deferred ở S97 — formalize điều đó).\n- **New rule**: nếu 1 rule có catch-rate = 0 sau 3 sessions, mark \"passive\" trong agent-notes header. Nếu 5 sessions = 0, REMOVE rule khỏi agent-notes (vẫn còn trong git history).\n- L-S87-1 cost ceiling về **0.3 K main** (không phải 0.5K). Vượt → mặc định promote-to-hook hoặc retire.\n\n### Layer 3 — Reframe tracking là forensic-first, working-memory-second (philosophical)\n- **Phân vai rõ ràng**:\n  - **Forensic** (write-often, read-rare): full session logs, full mistake entries, full event jsonl. **KHÔNG** load vào LLM context routine. letter)\n---\n\n# Q&A Bundle — S98 Tracking-Bloat RCA (CHARTER-tier)\n\n## Context\n\nUser escalated tracking-system bloat as Priority #1 mid-S98:\n> \"hệ thống file dùng để tracking đang quá nhiều và cồng kềnh... chi phí tracking, load track data, thời gian tracking đang KHÔNG hiệu quả so với cách sử dụng tracking data. cần cách tiếp cận hiệu quả cho longterm hơn\"\n\nEmpirical evidence at S98 close:\n- `current-execution.md`: **304 KB** (>256KB Read tool limit — broken)\n- `agent-notes.md`: 216 KB / 2008 LOC\n- `mistake-log.md`: 116 KB / 1175 LOC\n- `component-telemetry.jsonl`: **2.3 MB** (no rotation policy)\n- `memory/` total: ≈ **6.4 MB**\n- 71 hooks, 34 read current-execution, 10 read agent-notes\n- L-S87-1 cycle S91→S98: 8 sessions × ~0.4-1K main = **~5-8K main TỔNG**, catch-rate post-S94 = **0/4 = 0%** (Exhibit A: cost >> benefit, self-recursive trap)\n\nFull RCA in S98 chat response (preserved in checkpoint USER ESCALATION block).\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-1 — Triển khai Layer 1 (cap & compact) ngay S99?\n\n**Why-needed**: Layer 1 is the mechanical fix that resolves immediate tool-limit breakage. Decision frames how aggressive the cap thresholds are.\n\n- **A**: ✅ Full Layer 1 S99 (1 session impl ~5-8K main) — agent-notes 500 LOC cap, current-execution 5-session cap, mistake-log 200 LOC cap, telemetry weekly rotate. Archive overflow to `<file>/archive/YYYY-MM.md`. Add `tracking-retention.sh` hook (daily Stop). Add CLAUDE.md retention rule.\n- **B**: Triage — chỉ cap current-execution.md (urgent: tool-limit broken) + telemetry rotate; defer agent-notes/mistake-log cap to later session.\n- **C**: Bảo thủ — agent-notes 1000 LOC cap, current-execution 10-session cap, mistake-log 500 LOC cap (gấp đôi recommended).\n- **D**: Khác (nêu rõ thresholds).\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-2 — L-S87-1 + L-S90-1 + L-S94-1 cluster: demote / retire / giữ?\n\n**Why-needed**: This is the self-recursive codification trap (T2 in RCA). Decision determines whether we accept \"rule about rule about rule\" or break the cycle.\n\n- **A**: ✅ DEMOTE all 3 to **passive** — giữ rule trong agent-notes header nhưng KHÔNG audit routine mỗi session. Re-engage chỉ khi 1 signal cụ thể (e.g., backlog description bị ai đó question, hoặc quarterly check).\n- **B**: RETIRE all 3 hoàn toàn — xoá khỏi agent-notes (vẫn còn trong git history); promote dr-vs-passive heuristic thành deterministic hook (cheap).\n- **C**: Giữ L-S87-1 + L-S90-1 active, retire chỉ candidate L-S94-1.\n- **D**: Status quo — giữ tất cả như cũ; chấp nhận cost ~5-8K main / 8 sessions for 0% catch-rate.\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-3 — Layer 3 (reframe forensic vs working-memory split): triển khai?\n\n**Why-needed**: This is the philosophical reframe (T4 in RCA). Decision determines whether tracking files are FORENSIC (write-often-read-rare) or also WORKING-MEMORY (read-often).\n\n- **A**: ✅ YES — codify trong constitution `memory-tiers.md` (đã có draft từ Q-D3 closed; chỉ chưa codify). Forensic vs working-memory split. **Working-memory budget ≤ 20 KB** mỗi `continue` (boot-summary 4 KB + checkpoint 2 KB + routing 8 KB + project.md head 6 KB ≈ 20 KB). Forensic files (sessions/*, telemetry, full mistake-log, full agent-notes) NOT loaded routine — only on-demand grep.\n- **B**: YES nhưng chỉ áp dụng routine `continue`; on-demand task vẫn được full read khi cần.\n- **C**: NO — giữ current pattern (mọi tracking có thể là working memory khi cần).\n- **D**: Khác.\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-4 — Layer 4 (dedicated index files cho hot files): triển khai?\n\n**Why-needed**: This is the architecture fix (T3 hook fan-out). Decision determines whether we build deterministic index renderers to spare hooks from full-file reads.\n\n- **A**: ✅ YES — extend `index-registry-renderer.sh` cover agent-notes / mistake-log / current-execution. Output `<file>.idx.tsv` (1-5 KB each) auto-rendered Stop event. Hooks read INDEX (1-5 KB) thay vì FULL file (200+ KB). LLM read full file CHỈ khi authoring/grilling.\n- **B**: YES nhưng chỉ index agent-notes (lesson-id-line-anchor-status map) — cost/benefit clearest ở đây.\n- **C**: NO — dùng grep on-demand đơn giản hơn (no index file, no maintenance overhead).\n- **D**: Khác.\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-5 — Session ritual cleanup (drain rituals đang tự duy trì)?\n\n**Why-needed**: This is the entrenchment trap (T5). Decision determines whether mỗi-session rituals must justify cost/benefit periodically.\n\n- **A**: ✅ YES — mỗi ritual (L-S87-1 audit / drift-rollup re-scan / sync-grilling refresh / per-session log / current-execution prepend) phải có **catch-rate threshold + dormancy clock**. Catch-rate < X% over Y sessions → auto-demote to passive.\n- **B**: Chỉ drop L-S87-1 audit (clearest 0% case); giữ drift-rollup + sync-grilling + per-session log.\n- **C**: Drop tất cả mỗi-session rituals; chuyển sang **weekly aggregator** (1 hook chạy weekly, gộp drift-rollup + audit + sync-grilling).\n- **D**: Status quo.\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-6 — Component-telemetry.jsonl 2.3 MB (chưa rõ ai dùng)?\n\n**Why-needed**: Largest single file in memory/, no rotation policy, unclear ROI.\n\n- **A**: ✅ Audit ai đọc (per grep: `self-awareness-aggregate.sh` + `profile-template-auto-populate.sh`); rotate **weekly**, retain **4 weeks** max, archive `component-telemetry.YYYY-WNN.jsonl.gz`. Add `telemetry-rotate.sh` daily Stop hook.\n- **B**: Drop file hoàn toàn nếu post-audit ROI < threshold.\n- **C**: Giữ nguyên (không bùng vì JSONL append-only và memory disk còn nhiều).\n- **D**: Khác.\n\n---\n\n## Q-RCA-7 — Promote-to-hook trade-off khi LLM rule có catch-rate thấp?\n\n**Why-needed**: Sets the policy for when LLM-rule should become deterministic hook vs retired vs kept.\n\n- **A**: ✅ Khi 1 LLM rule (e.g. L-S87-1) catch-rate = 0 over 3+ sessions → mặc định **promote-to-hook** (1-time impl cost ~3K) **HOẶC retire**. KHÔNG tích luỹ thêm refinement inline (như đã xảy ra với L-S90-1 → L-S94-1 candidate).\n- **B**: Promote-to-hook là LAST resort; rule-codification (lesson-tích-luỹ) ưu tiên.\n- **C**: Status quo — rule tích luỹ trong agent-notes; review tay khi nhớ.\n- **D**: Khác.\n\n---\n\n## Lifecycle\n\n- **status**: pending\n- **expected**: user picks 1 letter per Q (A-D); explicit picks required per Q-B2 (CHARTER/SCOPE-tier no default acceptance)\n- **next-step on receipt**: S99 begins with reading user picks → produces Layer 1 impl plan (deterministic) + Layer 2-4 ADR drafts (per picks) → user ratifies before commit\n\nWhen answered: update `status: answered-via-chat-YYYY-MM-DD` + add `answer:` block per Q. then\n    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))\n    VIOLATION_LINES=\"$VIOLATION_LINES\n[$TS] tracking-retention: current-execution.md LOC=$CE_LOC > cap 200 (suggest archive oldest sessions to dated archive file)\"\n  fi\n  if [ \"$CE_SESSIONS\" -gt 5 ]; then\n    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))\n    VIOLATION_LINES=\"$VIOLATION_LINES\n[$TS] tracking-retention: agent-notes.md LOC=$AN_LOC > cap 700 (digest section grew; consider sub-archive)\"\n  fi\n  # If digest-only policy held, ### L-S header count = 0 in main file (digest uses table rows, not ### headers)\n  if [ \"$AN_LESSONS\" -gt 0 ]; then\n    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))\n    VIOLATION_LINES=\"$VIOLATION_LINES\n[$TS] tracking-retention: agent-notes.md has $AN_LESSONS full ### L-S lesson bodies inline (cap policy = digest only; archive bodies to agent-notes-archive-YYYY-MM-DD.md)\"\n  fi\nfi\n\n# Cap 3: mistake-log.md ≤ 200 LOC; full ### M-S bodies should NOT be inline (digest only)\nML_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/mistake-log.md\"\nif [ -f \"$ML_FILE\" ]; then\n  ML_LOC=$(wc -l < \"$ML_FILE\" 2>/dev/null)\n  ML_LOC=\"${ML_LOC:-0}\"\n  ML_MISTAKES=$(grep -c \"^### M-S\" \"$ML_FILE\" 2>/dev/null)\n  ML_MISTAKES=\"${ML_MISTAKES:-0}\"\n  if [ \"$ML_LOC\" -gt 200 ]; then\n    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))\n    VIOLATION_LINES=\"$VIOLATION_LINES\n[$TS] tracking-retention: mistake-log.md has $ML_MISTAKES full ### M-S mistake bodies inline (cap policy = digest only; archive to mistake-log-archive-YYYY-MM-DD.md)\"\n  fi\nfi\n\n# Cap 4: component-telemetry.jsonl ≤ 10 MB (weekly rotate handled by telemetry-rotate.sh)\nTEL_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/component-telemetry.jsonl\"\nif [ -f \"$TEL_FILE\" ]; then\n  TEL_BYTES=$(stat -c %s \"$TEL_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %z \"$TEL_FILE\" 2>/dev/null)\n  TEL_BYTES=\"${TEL_BYTES:-0}\"\n  if [ \"$TEL_BYTES\" -gt 10485760 ]; then\n    VIOLATIONS=$((VIOLATIONS + 1))\n    VIOLATION_LINES=\"$VIOLATION_LINES\n[$TS] tracking-retention: component-telemetry.jsonl size=$TEL_BYTES bytes > cap 10485760 (10 MB); Per RCA-2026-05-06-S98 user pick Q-RCA-6 = A.\n#\n# Wires: Stop hook in .claude/settings.json. Soft-warn only (exit 0 always; never blocks).\n# Trigger logic: idempotent week-based marker file. First Stop event of a new ISO week\n# rotates the file; subsequent Stops in the same week skip.\n#\n# Per L-S10-1: split-local; if/then/fi only.\n# Per L-S53-2: idempotency must advance per Stop-event, not per-SessionStart-tick (used here:\n#   marker advances on first rotation in week; subsequent same-week Stops skip).\n# Per L-S69-1: artifact-verifier whitelist — this hook writes archive files (.gz); not a target.\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.session-hooks.log\"\nMARKER=\"$MEM_DIR/.telemetry-last-rotate-week\"\nTEL_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/component-telemetry.jsonl\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$LOG\")\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# Skip if telemetry file doesn't exist yet\nif [ ! -f \"$TEL_FILE\" ]; then\n  printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: skip (no component-telemetry.jsonl)\\n' \"$TS\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Determine current ISO week (YYYY-WNN format)\nCURRENT_WEEK=\"$(date -u +%G-W%V 2>/dev/null)\"\nif [ -z \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" ]; then\n  printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: skip (cannot determine ISO week)\\n' \"$TS\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Read last-rotation week marker\nLAST_WEEK=\"\"\nif [ -f \"$MARKER\" ]; then\n  LAST_WEEK=\"$(cat \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null)\"\nfi\n\n# Skip if already rotated this week\nif [ \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" = \"$LAST_WEEK\" ]; then\n  printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: skip (already rotated week %s)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Skip rotation if file is small (< 100 KB) — no need to rotate weekly when tiny\nTEL_BYTES=$(stat -c %s \"$TEL_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %z \"$TEL_FILE\" 2>/dev/null)\nTEL_BYTES=\"${TEL_BYTES:-0}\"\nif [ \"$TEL_BYTES\" -lt 102400 ]; then\n  # Update marker anyway so we don't re-check until next week\n  printf '%s' \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" > \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null\n  printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: skip (size %s < 100KB; marker advanced to %s)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$TEL_BYTES\" \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Compute previous ISO week label for archive name\nPREV_WEEK=\"\"\nif [ -n \"$LAST_WEEK\" ]; then\n  PREV_WEEK=\"$LAST_WEEK\"\nelse\n  # First-ever rotation: use current-week minus 1 (best-effort label)\n  PREV_WEEK=\"$(date -u -d 'last week' +%G-W%V 2>/dev/null)\"\n  PREV_WEEK=\"${PREV_WEEK:-unknown-week}\"\nfi\n\nARCHIVE_DIR=\"$MEM_DIR/telemetry-archive\"\nmkdir -p \"$ARCHIVE_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\nARCHIVE_FILE=\"$ARCHIVE_DIR/component-telemetry.${PREV_WEEK}.jsonl.gz\"\n\n# Compress + truncate atomically\nif command -v gzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n  if gzip -c \"$TEL_FILE\" > \"$ARCHIVE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    : > \"$TEL_FILE\"  # truncate\n    printf '%s' \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" > \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null\n    printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: archived to %s; truncated %s; marker -> %s\\n' \\\n      \"$TS\" \"$ARCHIVE_FILE\" \"$TEL_FILE\" \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  else\n    printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: gzip failed; abort\\n' \"$TS\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n    exit 0\n  fi\nelse\n  # No gzip — fall back to plain copy + truncate\n  if cp \"$TEL_FILE\" \"${ARCHIVE_FILE%.gz}\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    : > \"$TEL_FILE\"\n    printf '%s' \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" > \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null\n    printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: no-gzip fallback; copied to %s; marker -> %s\\n' \\\n      \"$TS\" \"${ARCHIVE_FILE%.gz}\" \"$CURRENT_WEEK\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n  fi\nfi\n\n# Cleanup: delete archives older than 4 weeks (28 days)\nif command -v find >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n  if [ -d \"$ARCHIVE_DIR\" ]; then\n    DELETED=0\n    while IFS= read -r OLD_FILE; do\n      if [ -f \"$OLD_FILE\" ]; then\n        rm -f \"$OLD_FILE\" 2>/dev/null && DELETED=$((DELETED + 1))\n      fi\n    done < <(find \"$ARCHIVE_DIR\" -type f -name 'component-telemetry.*' -mtime +28 2>/dev/null)\n    if [ \"$DELETED\" -gt 0 ]; then\n      printf '[%s] telemetry-rotate: cleaned %d archive(s) older than 28 days\\n' \"$TS\" \"$DELETED\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null\n    fi\n  fi\nfi\n\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2eada7d6-7723-45fa-a727-bbf59934e090","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"dc47f5fb-3322-4d5d-be02-b08995cddf58","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"1fbd9335-d472-480d-b75d-0ff23e7b24b9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_0182AJRJfxNCwieb31mXxjk5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_0188qfxrjEHuafhfnnuu7FDs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\constitution\\memory-tiers.md","content":"# Memory Tiers — Working Memory vs Forensic Archive\n\n> **Status**: codified 2026-05-06 at S99 per RCA-2026-05-06-S98 user picks Q-RCA-3 = A + Q-RCA-5 = A + Q-RCA-7 = A.\n> **Supersedes**: implicit \"all tracking is working memory\" pattern (was: read full agent-notes.md / current-execution.md / mistake-log.md every continue).\n> **Authority**: this is constitution-tier; changes require explicit user revision (per `agent-workspace/CLAUDE.md` deny-list).\n\n---\n\n## Why this artifact exists\n\nS91→S98 cycle exposed a structural failure: tracking files (`current-execution.md` 304 KB, `agent-notes.md` 216 KB, `mistake-log.md` 116 KB, `component-telemetry.jsonl` 2.3 MB) had grown to where:\n- `current-execution.md` exceeded the Read tool 256 KB limit ⇒ tooling could not read the very file claiming to be \"single source of truth\".\n- Loading these into LLM context every `continue` consumed 50-100 K tokens for routine bookkeeping with measurable catch-rate ≈ 0% (L-S87-1 audit cycle as Exhibit A).\n- 34 hooks read `current-execution.md` per Stop event — most needing only top section but reading full file.\n\nUser escalated: tracking cost > tracking benefit; need long-term efficient approach.\n\nThis file codifies the split: **working memory** (loaded routine, ≤ 20 KB budget) vs **forensic archive** (write-often-read-rare, on-demand grep).\n\n---\n\n## Tier 1 — Working Memory (load every `continue`)\n\n**Budget**: ≤ 20 KB combined. ANY file in this tier MUST stay under its sub-cap.\n\n| File | Sub-cap | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| `agent-workspace/memory/boot-summary.md` | ≤ 4 KB | auto-rendered compact bootstrap |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/checkpoints/latest.md` | ≤ 8 KB | active session handoff state |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/routing-config.md` | ≤ 8 KB | model × effort × task-class routing |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` head section | ≤ 6 KB | active phase + last-5-ADR pointers |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md` | ≤ 24 KB (relaxed) | last 5 sessions only; older archived |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` digest | (full file ≤ 700 LOC; ~92 KB charter rules + digest) | charter rules inline; lesson digest (1 line per L-S<N>-<M>) |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log.md` digest | ≤ 200 LOC / ~10 KB | header + digest table only |\n\n**Rule**: any agent reading these may load them in full. Hooks reading these may load them in full but should prefer index-derived projections where available (see Tier 1.5).\n\n---\n\n## Tier 1.5 — Index Projections (cheap deterministic views)\n\n**Purpose**: hooks that need only metadata (header counts, line anchors, status flags) read these instead of full Tier 1 files. Auto-rendered by `index-registry-renderer.sh` Stop hook.\n\n| Index file | Source | Projection |\n|---|---|---|\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/lesson-registry.tsv` | agent-notes.md digest table | lesson_id ∣ status ∣ severity ∣ archive_line |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/mistake-registry.tsv` | mistake-log.md digest table | mistake_id ∣ session ∣ severity ∣ archive_line |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/decision-registry.tsv` | decisions/* directory | decision_id ∣ status ∣ phase ∣ tier |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/hook-registry.tsv` | scripts/hooks/* | hook_name ∣ event ∣ severity ∣ last_modified |\n\nHooks SHOULD read these (≤ 5 KB each) instead of full files when only metadata needed. Read on-demand via:\n- `Grep` for keyword search across files\n- `Read offset/limit` for specific section\n- `Glob` for filename patterns\n\nWhen agent or hook needs a specific lesson body, mistake body, or session log, read THAT file alone.
