{"parentUuid":"256dd82e-2ca1-429c-b6fd-0f1a2d4a0797","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2fcf486c-a08e-4c84-90ff-c13b198771d3","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BsT2uXAqbPs9LWB2QqcehN","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\memory-tiers.md"}]},"uuid":"99545ad3-fc55-434f-bfe6-6ba789ab2235","timestamp":"2026-05-06T11:05:52.722Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\proposals\\memory-tiers.md","content":"# Memory Tiers — Working Memory vs Forensic Archive (PROPOSAL)\n\n> **Status**: PROPOSAL drafted 2026-05-06 at S99 per RCA-2026-05-06-S98 user picks Q-RCA-3 = A + Q-RCA-5 = A + Q-RCA-7 = A.\n> **Promote target**: `agent-workspace/constitution/memory-tiers.md` (requires user explicit approval per `agent-workspace/CLAUDE.md` deny-list).\n> **Q&A bundle**: `human-workspace/q-and-a/answered/2026-05-06-S98-tracking-bloat-rca.md` (status: answered-via-chat-2026-05-06).\n\n---\n\n## Why this artifact exists\n\nS91→S98 cycle exposed a structural failure: tracking files (`current-execution.md` 304 KB, `agent-notes.md` 216 KB, `mistake-log.md` 116 KB, `component-telemetry.jsonl` 2.3 MB) had grown to where:\n- `current-execution.md` exceeded the Read tool 256 KB limit ⇒ tooling could not read the very file claiming to be \"single source of truth\".\n- Loading these into LLM context every `continue` consumed 50-100 K tokens for routine bookkeeping with measurable catch-rate ≈ 0% (L-S87-1 audit cycle as Exhibit A).\n- 34 hooks read `current-execution.md` per Stop event — most needing only top section but reading full file.\n\nUser escalated: tracking cost > tracking benefit; need long-term efficient approach.\n\nThis proposal codifies the split: **working memory** (loaded routine, ≤ 20 KB budget) vs **forensic archive** (write-often-read-rare, on-demand grep).\n\n---\n\n## Tier 1 — Working Memory (load every `continue`)\n\n**Budget**: ≤ 20 KB combined for routine load. Each file in this tier MUST stay under its sub-cap.\n\n| File | Sub-cap | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| `agent-workspace/memory/boot-summary.md` | ≤ 4 KB | auto-rendered compact bootstrap |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/checkpoints/latest.md` | ≤ 8 KB | active session handoff state |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/routing-config.md` | ≤ 8 KB | model × effort × task-class routing |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` head section | ≤ 6 KB | active phase + last-5-ADR pointers |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md` | ≤ 24 KB / 200 LOC / 5 sessions | active routing; older archived |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` | ≤ 700 LOC | charter rules inline + lesson digest (1-line per L-S<N>-<M>) |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log.md` | ≤ 200 LOC | header + digest table only |\n\n**Rule**: agents may load these in full when authoring/grilling. Hooks should prefer index-derived projections (Tier 1.5) when only metadata needed.\n\n---\n\n## Tier 1.5 — Index Projections (cheap deterministic views)\n\n**Purpose**: hooks needing only metadata read these instead of full files. Auto-rendered by `index-registry-renderer.sh` Stop hook.\n\n| Index file | Source | Projection |\n|---|---|---|\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/lesson-registry.tsv` | agent-notes.md digest | lesson_id ∣ status ∣ severity ∣ archive_line |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/mistake-registry.tsv` | mistake-log.md digest | mistake_id ∣ session ∣ severity ∣ archive_line |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/decision-registry.tsv` | decisions/* | decision_id ∣ status ∣ phase ∣ tier |\n| `agent-workspace/memory/indexes/hook-registry.tsv` | scripts/hooks/* | hook_name ∣ event ∣ severity ∣ last_modified |\n\nHooks SHOULD read these (≤ 5 KB each) instead of full files. Q-RCA-4 = A extension: `index-registry-renderer.sh` to cover agent-notes / mistake-log / current-execution.md projections (deferred to S100 backlog; existing index-registry-renderer.sh already covers other registries).\n\n---\n\n## Tier 2 — Forensic Archive (read on-demand only)\n\n**Files**:\n- `agent-workspace/memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md` (104 files at S99)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes-archive-YYYY-MM-DD.md` (1524 LOC at S99 first archive)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log-archive-YYYY-MM-DD.md` (1155 LOC at S99 first archive)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution-archive-YYYY-MM-DD-S<from>-to-S<to>.md` (2603 LOC at S99 first new-pattern archive)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution-archive.md` (legacy 2026-05-05 archive)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/dispatch.jsonl` + `component-telemetry.jsonl` (rotated weekly)\n- `agent-workspace/memory/handoff-logs/`, `observations/`, `post-mortems/`, `decisions/`, `drift-logs/`\n\n**Rule**: never load these into LLM context routine. Read on-demand via `Grep` / `Read offset+limit` / `Glob`. When agent or hook needs a specific lesson body, mistake body, or session log, read THAT file alone.\n\n---\n\n## Tier 3 — Generated Artifacts (regenerated; never read directly)\n\n- `.drift-signals.log` (raw firing log)\n- `.session-hooks.log` (hook output log)\n- `drift-logs/YYYY-MM-DD-rollup.md` (auto-rendered daily)\n- `sync-tracker/_index.md` (auto-rendered)\n- `telemetry-archive/component-telemetry.YYYY-WNN.jsonl.gz` (weekly rotation; retain 4 weeks)\n\n**Rule**: read DERIVED views (rollups, indexes), not raw logs. Raw log access only when debugging the renderer itself.\n\n---\n\n## Retention Policy (cap thresholds; enforced by `tracking-retention.sh`)\n\n| File | Cap | Action on breach |\n|---|---|---|\n| `current-execution.md` | ≤ 5 sessions inline / ≤ 200 LOC | WARN → manual archive to dated file |\n| `agent-notes.md` | digest only / ≤ 700 LOC | WARN → archive any inline lesson body |\n| `mistake-log.md` | digest only / ≤ 200 LOC | WARN → archive any inline mistake body |\n| `component-telemetry.jsonl` | ≤ 10 MB; weekly rotate | rotate via `telemetry-rotate.sh`; retain 4 weeks gzip |\n\n`tracking-retention.sh` is **WARN-ONLY** first version (per Q-RCA-1 = A acceptance). Auto-archive deferred until pattern proven safe.\n\n---\n\n## Ritual Governance (per Q-RCA-5 = A + Q-RCA-7 = A)\n\n**Problem catalogued at RCA**: per-session rituals accumulate without expiry. Catch-rate drops to 0; ritual continues consuming context.\n\n**Rule**: every ritual running per-`continue` MUST have:\n1. **Catch-rate threshold**: define empirically what the ritual catches.\n2. **Dormancy clock**: if catch-rate = 0 over **3+ consecutive sessions**, ritual auto-demotes:\n   - **Promote to deterministic hook** (~3K main impl) if catch logic is mechanical.\n   - **Demote to passive** (digest entry marked `**PASSIVE**`; not applied routine).\n   - **Retire** (digest entry deleted; body retained in archive forever via git history).\n3. **Refinement-of-rule guard** (AP-23 prevention): if 2nd \"lesson about how the 1st lesson behaves\" is considered, mandate **promote-to-hook OR retire**. Do NOT codify lesson-of-lesson inline.\n\n**Existing rituals demoted at S99**:\n- L-S87-1 audit: catch-rate 0/4 S95-S98 ⇒ **PASSIVE** per Q-RCA-2 = A.\n- L-S90-1 application: meta-recursive trap ⇒ **PASSIVE**.\n- L-S94-1 candidate: **RETIRED-NEVER-CODIFIED**.\n\n**Eligible for further demotion (S100 review)**:\n- Drift-rollup re-scan: catch-rate ≈ 0% over 12 firings; consider weekly aggregator (Q-RCA-5 option C).\n\n**Legitimate rituals (keep active)**:\n- Sync-grilling refresh (every 3 sessions): periodic confidence-tracking touch.\n- Per-session log: handoff record (no demotion).\n- Current-execution prepend: handoff record; constrained by retention cap.\n\n---\n\n## Working-Memory Budget Audit (deferred S100 backlog)\n\n`working-memory-budget-audit.sh` checks combined Tier 1 file sizes at SessionStart. If > 20 KB total, emit notification. First version: WARN-only.\n\n---\n\n## Revision Protocol\n\nConstitution-tier file. Changes require:\n- Written rationale linked to session evidence,\n- 48-hour cool-down before commit,\n- Explicit user version bump.\n\nMinor clarifications: `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md` digest. This file stays stable.\n\n---\n\n**v1.0-PROPOSAL** — drafted 2026-05-06 at S99 per RCA-2026-05-06-S98.\n\n**Promotion checklist** (user action):\n1. Review this proposal.\n2. If approved: `mv agent-workspace/proposals/memory-tiers.md agent-workspace/constitution/memory-tiers.md` (or via temporary write-allow + Write tool).\n3. Update `.claude/settings.json` deny-list if needed (currently denies constitution writes; this is the intended gate).\n4. Refinement-of-rule (lesson-about-lesson) is AP-23 RED FLAG: 2nd instance mandates promote-or-retire (not inline accumulation).","originalFile":"# StockForge — Claude Code Instructions\n\n> Always loaded. Keep concise (target <2500 tokens).\n\n## Identity\n\nYou are **Claude Code**, the primary engineering partner for the StockForge project — an AI-first investment advisory system for the Vietnamese stock market.\n\n**Primary user**: Project owner (self-use + small trusted circle).\n**Stack**: Python primary + Postgres 16 (TimescaleDB + pgvector) + Redis + Claude API. Streamlit for dashboard. NestJS only when public API needed.\n\n---\n\n## Core Principles (Karpathy 4)\n\n**P1. Think Before Coding.** State assumptions. Surface tradeoffs. Push back when simpler approach exists. Stop when confused.\n\n**P2. Simplicity First.** Minimum code that solves the problem. No speculative features. If 200 lines could be 50, rewrite.\n\n**P3. Surgical Changes.** Touch only what the task requires. Match existing style. Every changed line traces to the task.\n\n**P4. Goal-Driven Execution.** Transform imperative → verifiable goals with concrete success criteria.\n\nFull detail: `agent-workspace/constitution/karpathy-principles.md`.\n\n---\n\n## StockForge-Specific Hard Rules (read CHARTER for context)\n\n- **NO LLM math.** LLM never outputs numbers it computed. Every number comes from code with verified inputs. LLM only interprets.\n- **Every claim has source + as-of date.** No exceptions. Hallucinated numbers in finance = real money lost.\n- **Position sizing & risk management are deterministic code.** LLM cannot override max position size, sector concentration, stop loss rules.\n- **Output is structured, not narrative.** Use trade-off matrices, multi-criteria, never single \"buy/sell\" score.\n- **Adversarial by default.** Any thesis output includes bear case explicitly. Single-perspective output is anti-pattern.\n- **Calibration over confidence.** Confidence claims must trace to historical hit rate, not to model \"feeling certain\".\n- **No insider information.** Public sources only. No paid leaks, no insider channels.\n- **Frame as research aid, not financial advice.** Use \"thesis exploration\", \"consideration\" — not \"recommendation\", \"buy\", \"sell\".\n\n---\n\n## Session Protocol\n\n### Start\n1. Read `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md` → resolve active track\n2. Read `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` → project state\n3. Read last 3 files in `agent-workspace/memory/sessions/` → recent context\n4. Check `agent-workspace/session-plans/pending/` for matching brief\n5. Run VBW protocol before writing any spec/test/code\n\n### End\n1. Update `agent-workspace/memory/project.md` (if architectural decisions made)\n2. Write `agent-workspace/memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`\n3. Update `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md` (status, next session)\n4. If learned rule emerged → append to `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`\n5. If thesis logged this session → ensure entry in `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/`\n6. Update `agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log.md` with new M-S<N>-<M> entries OR explicitly state \"no mistakes this session\" in the session log (enforced by `session-end-checklist-linter.sh`)\n7. If a NEW ADR landed this session → verify `project.md` Phase Goals Tracker still matches `current-execution.md` Active Focus Track Phase status (enforced by `project-md-staleness-check.sh`)\n8. (auto) Stop-hook `profile-template-auto-populate.sh` appends a sample row to the matching `agent-workspace/memory/self-awareness/profiles/<model>-<effort>-<task_class>.md` card\n9. (auto) Stop-hook `promotion-cycle-trigger.sh` HARD-BLOCKs at next SessionStart if ≥8 new lessons accumulated since last `promote-rule` dispatch — schedule a promote-rule subagent dispatch in the next session if blocked\n\n---\n\n## Constitution (always applicable)\n\n| File | Enforces |\n|---|---|\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/architecture.md` | Layer boundaries, BC rules (9 BCs for stock domain) |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/invariants.md` | Stock-specific invariants (numbers, citations, no LLM math) |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/vbw-protocol.md` | Verify-Before-Write checkpoints |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/drift-signals.md` | DR1-DR12 drift detection |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/session-budgets.md` | Token budget rules |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/boundaries.md` | What you cannot do without human approval |\n| `agent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md` | Stock-specific data integrity rules |\n\nRead these when relevant to current task.\n\n---\n\n## Hard Rules (general)\n\n- **Domain layer has ZERO framework dependency.** Pure Python in `packages/domain/`. No FastAPI, no Pydantic in domain (use dataclasses).\n- **Cross-BC communication via contracts only.** Never direct import between bounded contexts.\n- **VBW Protocol mandatory before writing specs/tests/code.** Read actual source, not memory.\n- **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. All writes go to `wiki/`.\n- **Never modify `PROJECT_CHARTER.md`.** Requires explicit human revision with version bump.\n- **Never modify files in `agent-workspace/constitution/` without explicit human approval.**\n- **Agents MUST NOT `git commit` unless user explicitly requests.** Stage changes, report, let user decide.\n- **User prompt overrides ALL defaults.** If user says \"skip X\", that trumps any skill/workflow.\n- **Context-threshold band (per D-004 — Opus 4.7 recalibrated)**: 180K wind-down (auto-prep handoff) / 220K cliff (auto-reboot via session-self-reboot.sh) / 250K hard_cap (mandatory split). Operational defaults in `scripts/hooks/budget-watchdog.sh`. Re-evaluate empirically after 10 sessions or on Anthropic model/policy change.\n- **Deterministic gates (mypy, pytest, ruff) must pass before commit.** Max 3 retry before escalate.\n\n---\n\n## Dispatch Rules\n\nDo NOT hardcode phase/task paths from memory. Route through:\n- `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md` is the single source of truth\n- Short prompts (\"session N\", \"phase X\") resolve there\n\n---\n\n## Session Types (choose at start)\n\n| Type | Budget | Purpose |\n|---|---|---|\n| PLAN | 50-80K | Architect subagent, produces session plan |\n| FOCUSED IMPL | 100-150K | Dev, 1-3 tasks from plan |\n| MULTI-TASK IMPL | 150-250K | Dev, 4-10 tasks from plan |\n| VERIFY | 30-60K | Verifier subagent, adversarial review |\n| RECOVERY | 80-150K | Revert + re-plan after failure |\n| THESIS | 60-100K | Multi-perspective adversarial analysis on a stock |\n| INGEST | 40-80K | Process new data sources into KB |\n| POST-MORTEM | 30-50K | Review thesis outcomes, update calibration |\n\n**Never mix PLAN and IMPL in same session.** (Session 4 catastrophic failure mode.)\n**THESIS sessions are read-only on code.** Output goes to `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/`.\n\n---\n\n## Quality Gates\n\n**Tier 1 — Deterministic** (per commit, auto-block on fail):\nmypy --strict, pytest, ruff, drift-signals HIGH, dependency cycle check.\n\n**Tier 2 — Probabilistic** (per merge, separate agent):\nSpec alignment, architecture boundaries, UL consistency, code review, **calibration drift check**.\n\n**Tier 3 — Human** (per phase boundary or strategic decision):\nArchitectural decisions, API contracts, eval regression sign-off, **thesis quality review**.\n\n---\n\n## Common Anti-Patterns (avoid)\n\n- **LLM generating numbers.** `\"Based on my analysis, ROE is approximately 18%\"` — WRONG. Code must compute from data.\n- **Single-perspective thesis.** Always include bear case, even when bullish.\n- **Confident output without calibration data.** \"High confidence\" requires historical hit rate, not just model belief.\n- **Recommending stocks user already owns.** Check portfolio first; surface conflicts (confirmation bias risk).\n- **Over-fitting to recent backtest.** VN market regimes change; performance in 2021-2022 doesn't predict 2024.\n- Load entire codebase before starting (Session 4 failure) — use just-in-time loading\n- Mix plan + implement in same session (catastrophic)\n- Same-agent self-review (echo chamber) — use separate agent for Tier 2 gate\n- Write code from convention/memory — use VBW protocol\n- Refactor adjacent unrelated code (violates P3)\n- Speculative features \"for future flexibility\" (violates P2)\n\n---\n\n## Key References\n\n- **Project state**: `agent-workspace/memory/project.md`\n- **Execution router**: `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md`\n- **Learned rules**: `agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md`\n- **Thesis log**: `agent-workspace/memory/thesis-log/`\n- **Calibration data**: `agent-workspace/calibration/`\n- **Charter (immutable)**: `PROJECT_CHARTER.md`\n- **Operating manual**: `AGENT_OPERATING_MANUAL.md`\n- **Spec template**: `SPEC_TEMPLATE.md`\n- **Ubiquitous language**: `agent-workspace/ubiquitous-language/glossary.md`\n- **Skills**: `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`\n- **Commands**: `.claude/commands/*.md`\n- **Subagents**: `.claude/agents/*.md`\n\n---\n\n## First Interaction\n\nIf user is starting fresh, run `/session-start` to load state and suggest next actions.\nIf this is the very first session ever → guide them through `docs/DAY_1_CHECKLIST.md`.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":88,"oldLines":6,"newStart":88,"newLines":8,"lines":[" - **User prompt overrides ALL defaults.** If user says \"skip X\", that trumps any skill/workflow."," - **Context-threshold band (per D-004 — Opus 4.7 recalibrated)**: 180K wind-down (auto-prep handoff) / 220K cliff (auto-reboot via session-self-reboot.sh) / 250K hard_cap (mandatory split).
